input_port.name: timeout
input_port.description: Timeout in seconds waiting for Nav2 action server

Action.doc: Waits for the /navigate_to_pose action server to become available. Returns SUCCESS when ready, FAILURE on timeout.

input_port.name: force_failure
input_port.description: If true, node will fail (for testing)

Action.doc: STUB: Simulates rotating until ArUco markers are detected. Real version will subscribe to ArUco detections and rotate until markers are seen.

input_port.name: pose_name
input_port.description: Name of pose to look up from parameters (e.g., excavation_staging)

Action.doc: Sends a Nav2 NavigateToPose goal using pose [x, y, yaw] from mission_params.yaml (poses.pose_name). Returns RUNNING until goal completes, then SUCCESS/FAILURE.
STUB: Simulates excavation/claw pickup. Real version will call mechanical team's claw action server.
STUB: Simulates dumping sand at construction zone. Real version will call mechanical team's claw action server.
Emergency stop: cancels any active Nav2 goal and publishes zero Twist on /cmd_vel.

input_port.name: zone_name
input_port.description: Name of zone to check (e.g., excavation)

Condition.doc: Checks if robot (base_footprint in map frame) is within rectangular zone from mission_params.yaml (zones.zone_name = [x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max]).
Returns SUCCESS while elapsed mission time < time_limit, FAILURE when time expires.

input_port.name: timeout
input_port.description: Time window to consider markers recent (seconds)

Condition.doc: STUB: Always returns FAILURE to force fallback to LocateMarkers. Real version checks ArUco detection timestamps.

input_port.name: state
input_port.description: Mission state to announce (e.g., TRAVEL, EXCAVATE)

Action.doc: Logs the state and publishes std_msgs/String to /mission/state topic. Returns SUCCESS immediately.
